Project the voxel center onto the image plane of view $i$ to find the corresponding pixel coordinates.

Calculate the Euclidean distance $d_{voxel}$ from the voxel center to the camera position of view $i$.

**Color:** For each view where the voxel is visible, bilinearly interpolate the color from the neighboring pixels in the color image.
